execution_notes: This file records the budget; it is not an active billing cap or a provisioner.
Verify current inventory, the actual all-resource hourly quote, tax and existing charges before launch.
Any further GPU time counts toward the same total budget, including environment setup and idle time.
Stop before compute reaches its envelope; storage can continue billing after a Pod stops.
Maintain a local copy of checkpoints before any separately authorized cloud-storage deletion.
No claim is made that both language models will reach acceptable quality within this budget.
The current Runpod plugin documents that stop-after/terminate-after flags were not enforced and were removed. They are not a billing guard.
User selected local Mac storage instead of a separately billed network volume.
Creation of a no-volume Pod failed with a valid-request capacity error; a fresh list-pods read confirmed none exist.
Remote temporary disk still bills while the Pod is running. No remote storage should remain billable after a verified stop.
Keep datasets locally, copy working data to the Pod, and sync checkpoints/results to the Mac before stop, restart, reset or termination.
cost_control: Sync and verify local checkpoints/results, then explicitly stop GPU compute. Temporary Pod data is lost on stop.
storage_strategy: Mac holds master data; cloud Pod uses temporary container disk only; sync results before stop
